gloss: just in case; by any chance

definitions.gloss: just in case, by any chance
definitions.explanation: Used to express a very unlikely but possible scenario. Literally "one in ten thousand." Often paired with conditional forms (〜たら、〜ば) or the expression の{場合|ばあい}は to describe precautionary measures or worst-case scenarios.

examples.japanese: {万|まん}が{一|いち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
{万|まん}が{一|いち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I got insurance just in case.

examples.japanese: {万|まん}が{一|いち}⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きたら→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{非常口|ひじょうぐち}→非常口：07045_hijouguchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|に}げて→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: In the unlikely event of a fire, please escape through this emergency exit.

notes:
{万|まん}が{一|いち} literally means "one in ten thousand" and is used to talk about unlikely but possible events. It is more emphatic than ⟦もし→もし：01284_moshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ and carries a stronger sense of improbability.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {万|まん}が{一|いち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧ (prepare for the worst)
- {万|まん}が{一|いち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (just in case)
- {万|まん}が{一|いち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧ (in the unlikely event)
- {万|まん}が{一|いち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧ (worst-case scenario)

USAGE:
- Typically used with conditional patterns: {万|まん}が{一|いち}〜たら / 〜ば
- Often appears in formal warnings, safety instructions, and insurance contexts
- Can function as a noun when followed by ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {万|まん}が{一|いち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}
